quizzes.title: MCQ: Division with remainders
quizzes.instructions: Remember: the remainder is always smaller than the divisor.

questions.explanation: 4 × 5 = 20 fits inside 23 leaving remainder 3; in option b the quotient 6 overshoots (4 × 6 = 24 > 23), and option d has an impossible remainder 7 > 4.

questions.prompt: When dividing by 7, which remainder is impossible?
questions.explanation: A remainder must be smaller than the divisor; 7 would mean one more group of 7 fits.

questions.prompt: In the k-table for divisor 6, the largest k whose multiple fits inside 50 is 8. What is the remainder of 50 ÷ 6?

quizzes.title: MCQ: Numbers with the same remainder
quizzes.instructions: Use the family formula d × k + r.

questions.prompt: Numbers leaving remainder 3 when divided by 5 have which form?
questions.explanation: Family members are d × k + r = 5k + 3: 3, 8, 13, 18, …

questions.prompt: Two numbers both leave remainder 2 when divided by 6. What is the difference between them?
questions.explanation: Family members step by the divisor: (6a + 2) − (6b + 2) = 6(a − b), a multiple of 6.

questions.prompt: Is 100 in the family of numbers leaving remainder 4 when divided by 8?

options.text: Yes — all even numbers leave remainder 4

quizzes.title: Descriptive: Describe a remainder family
quizzes.instructions: Write a clear explanation with an example. You may use letters like d, k and r for a general argument.

questions.prompt: Describe all numbers that leave remainder 2 when divided by 5. Give the general form, list the first few, and explain how far apart consecutive members are.
questions.modelAnswer: Numbers leaving remainder 2 when divided by 5 are exactly the numbers of the form 5k + 2 for k = 0, 1, 2, 3, …: that is 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, …. Subtracting the remainder 2 leaves a multiple of 5, and consecutive members differ by exactly 5.

quizzes.title: MCQ: Remainder puzzles
quizzes.instructions: Translate each clue into a family, then intersect.

questions.prompt: A number leaves remainder 1 when divided by both 2 and 3. What is the smallest such number above 1?
questions.explanation: Odd numbers: 1, 3, 5, 7, … Numbers of the form 3k + 1: 1, 4, 7, 10, … The smallest common member above 1 is 7.

questions.prompt: A mystery number is of the form 4k + 1 and is less than 20 but greater than 10. Which could it be?
questions.explanation: The family is 1, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, … Between 10 and 20 the members are 13 and 17 — and 13 is listed.

questions.prompt: A number leaves remainder 0 when divided by 4 and remainder 1 when divided by 3. Which number below 25 satisfies both?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4 under 25: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24. Which leaves remainder 1 mod 3? 16 = 3 × 5 + 1 ✓. (12 and 24 leave remainder 0; 8 leaves 2.)
